provenance: Parameters, offsets, encodings and raw ranges: Roland XP-60/XP-80 owner's manual, MIDI Implementation, Parameter Address Map,
via the legacy XP60Studio transcription (read-only source). Status of every row: documentation-derived.
Cross-checked against a real XP-60 user bank (128 patches, 74,752 values, 0 out of range) and the Patch Base XP-80 samples.
NOT confirmed by this project on hardware. Owner confirmation is required before any row is called verified.
